full_prompt_en: A square Dutch-style realist oil painting shows a young gentleman relaxing in a dark wooden chair inside an ornate, dim interior. He sits just left of center, leaning back with one arm hooked along the chair and his legs crossed loosely toward the lower right. A broad black hat crowns shoulder-length brown curls, casting a light shadow across his calm face. His rust-red coat opens over a warm ocher waistcoat and trousers. A bright white cravat falls down the chest in layered folds, echoed by white lace at the cuffs. Tall polished brown boots catch narrow highlights and point toward the right edge, making the crossed legs a prominent diagonal. To the left of the chair, a small table covered with a patterned red-brown textile holds a glass and a few pale indistinct items. Heavy dark drapery hangs at the far left, partly framing the table. Behind the seated man, a warm gray wall carries faint decorative drawing and a small oval framed image near the upper center. On the right, a tall richly carved or painted wooden panel occupies almost a third of the frame, its gold-brown figures and scrolls dissolving into deep shade. The lower area includes dark chair legs, patterned flooring, and a soft shadow beneath the boots. Warm side light enters from the upper left, illuminating the face, cravat, coat folds, and boot leather while allowing corners and carved recesses to remain almost black. The paint models flesh and fabric smoothly, then turns more textured through wood grain, textile pattern, and gold decoration. No legible words appear. The overall composition places a relaxed human presence among weighty vertical furnishings, balancing pale cloth and red-brown clothing against the interior's layered darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形荷兰风格写实油画描绘一位年轻绅士在华丽昏暗的室内，悠然靠坐于深色木椅中。他位于中央偏左，身体后靠，一条手臂搭在椅边，双腿松散交叠并伸向右下。宽阔黑帽戴在及肩棕色卷发上，在平静面容上投下浅影。铁锈红外套敞开，露出暖赭色背心和长裤。明亮白领巾以层叠褶皱垂在胸前，袖口白色蕾丝与之呼应。高筒抛光棕靴接住狭窄高光，鞋尖伸向右边，让交叉双腿成为显眼斜线。椅子左边，一张铺红棕花纹布的小桌上放着玻璃杯与几个浅色但不清楚的小物。厚重深色帷幔悬在最左边，部分框住桌子。坐姿男子身后，暖灰墙面带淡淡装饰图样，靠上方中央有一幅小椭圆框画。右侧一面高高的木质雕饰或绘饰板占据近三分之一，金棕色人物与卷草纹融入深影。下方有深色椅脚、花纹地面和靴底的柔和阴影。暖侧光从左上进入，照亮面容、领巾、外套褶皱和靴面皮革，让角落与雕刻凹处接近黑色。颜料平滑塑造肌肤与衣料，到了木纹、桌布花纹和金色装饰处变得更有肌理。没有可读文字。整体构图把放松的人物置于有分量的竖向陈设之间，以浅色布料和红棕衣物对照室内的层叠黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a polished Dutch-style realist oil finish, with warm flesh and fabric modeled carefully inside an ornate low-lit setting. Rust, tobacco brown, muted gold, charcoal, and soft ivory form a compact rich palette. Broad shadow masses are interrupted by selective pale cloth, tiny glass glints, and narrow highlights on reflective surfaces. Focal contours remain clean, while carved and patterned recesses merge into textured darks. Warm lateral light gives rounded volume to near forms and deepens the layered background without flattening it. A substantial seated-like central mass is framed by vertical dark structures and smaller low horizontal accents, producing quiet visual stability. The overall effect is intimate, refined, and gently theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有打磨精细的荷兰风格写实油画完成面，暖色肌肤与织物在华丽低照度环境中被细心塑造。铁锈色、烟草棕、低调金色、炭色和柔象牙白形成紧凑而丰厚的调色。大片阴影由局部浅色布料、细小玻璃闪光和反光表面的狭窄高光打断。焦点轮廓干净，雕饰与花纹凹处则融入有肌理的深色。暖侧光赋予近处形体圆润体积，并加深层叠背景，却不使其平面化。一片分量足的中央形体由竖向暗结构和较小低位水平强调围住，形成安静的视觉稳定。整体效果亲近、精致且温和地富于戏剧性。
theme_en: A relaxed gentleman seated in an ornate dark interior
theme_zh: 华丽暗色室内悠然坐着的绅士
name: Gabriel Metsu
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
